text:
Morgan (partnerships): ok kicking off publisher onboarding for ACME Cloud Suite — goal: get AWS/GCP/Azure listings live and a demo tenant for the joint announcement. timeline 3 weeks. who can own legal + assets?
Sanjay (legal): I can take legal. quick heads-up: vendor provided a standard MSA but there are two risky clauses — broad indemnity and unknown subprocessor list. need redlines by Tue EOD.
Tess (product): product ask: 14-day trial, pre-bundled connectors, and telemetry opt-in. need SKU mapping for trial vs paid. can someone draft SKU/feature matrix?
Liam (eng): for cloud artifacts we'll need: AMI for AWS, container image + Terraform module for GCP/Azure, and signed manifests. prefer bundle: `marketplace-assets-v1.zip` with `README.md` and `checksums.txt`. also please provide public demo data sample (anonymized).
Dina (solutions): I can own the demo tenant + demo script. request: demo creds, sample org, and a sandbox quota. will also record a 5-min walkthrough video.
Sanjay (legal): tagging @Morgan — also request a copy of partner's DPA and SOC report. if they can't provide SOC, we'll need compensating controls.
Morgan (partnerships): action items: (1) Sanjay — redlines + DPA check by Tue EOD, (2) Tess — SKU matrix + trial params by Thu, (3) Liam — build artifact template + example AMI name by Fri, (4) Dina — demo tenant request form to partner now. I'll notify partner of timeline. :thumbsup:
Liam (eng): simple AMI naming suggestion: `redwood-acme-ami-YYYYMMDD`. sample S3 path for uploads: `s3://redwood-marketplace-uploads/acme-cloudsuite/`. terraform module ref: `github.com/redwood/marketplace-templates/acme`.
Tess (product): sample SKU matrix start: ["trial-basic", "pro-seats", "enterprise-annual"], limits: trial=14d, seats trial=3, api-requests/day=10k. sending sheet in a sec.
Dina (solutions): partner asks about listing screenshots and video guidelines — do we have a checklist?
Morgan (partnerships): yes — upload assets per marketplace spec: hero image 1200x600, logo SVG + PNG, screenshots (1280x720). I'll paste the checklist in thread.
marketplace-bot: checklist updated — assets required: hero.jpg, logo.svg, screenshot1.png, demo-video.mp4, license.pdf, entitlement-mapping.csv.
Sanjay (legal): small ask — mark any demo data that contains PII. if demo contains PII we need explicit consent and a data flow diagram.
Liam (eng): we'll sanitize sample dataset. will provide `sample_data_anonymized.csv` and a short script `anonymize.py` in the bundle.
Morgan (partnerships): timeline check: aiming for listing submission by next Wed, internal review on Mon. if legal redlines extend, contingency is to submit with placeholders and update after sign. thoughts?
Tess (product): fine with placeholders for non-security fields, not for pricing or entitlements.
Sanjay (legal): don't submit templates with open indemnities. if we must, mark as "pending legal" and restrict public visibility.
Dina (solutions): demo recording ready by Tue EOD if demo tenant created by Mon.
Morgan (partnerships): owners assigned in Asana. I'll ping partner to request DPA, logos, and demo creds now. tagging @Dina and @Liam to sync on sandbox network rules.
Liam (eng): noted. will share a minimal onboarding `README.md` with commands. example:```
# upload assets
aws s3 cp marketplace-assets-v1.zip s3://redwood-marketplace-uploads/acme-cloudsuite/ --acl private
```
Morgan (partnerships): perfect. thanks team — will post partner replies here. :rocket:
